brand.tagline: Smart recipes with what you have
brand.description: Manage kitchen stock, track expiration dates, and get AI-powered recipe suggestions from your ingredients.

auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in and continue in your kitchen
auth.registerSubtitle: Set up your recipe assistant in minutes
auth.passwordMinError: Password must be at least 6 characters
auth.privacyNote: By signing up you create your own kitchen home. Stock, recipes and shopping data are stored securely in the cloud.
auth.showcaseDescription: AI recipes, stock tracking, expiry alerts and shopping list — all in one app.
auth.featureStockDesc: Manage fridge and pantry items in one place.
auth.featureRecipesDesc: Get Gemini-powered recipe suggestions from your ingredients.
auth.featureShoppingDesc: Note what you need and take it to the store.

shopping.title: Shopping List
shopping.subtitle: Track missing ingredients
shopping.emptyDescription: Add missing recipe ingredients or anything you need. Take it with you to the store.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Family kitchen and preferences
settings.languageDescription: On first visit your browser language is used automatically. Change your preference here anytime.

family.loginRequired: Sign in for family sharing. Invite your partner and after approval you'll share the shopping list.
family.title: Family Kitchen
family.description: Invite a family member. After they approve, the shopping list is shared.
family.mockNote: Demo mode: invitations are simulated in the browser.
family.incomingEmpty: Kitchen invitations sent to you appear here.
family.inviteHint: The invited person must be registered. After acceptance, stock and shopping list are shared.
family.inviteSent: Invitation sent. Once accepted, you'll share the list.
family.inviteAccepted: Invitation accepted. You now see the shared shopping list.

errors.migrationRequired: Family invitation system is not set up. Run SQL files 006 and 008 in Supabase.

inventory.lookupNotFound: Barcode not found. You can enter the product name manually.
inventory.lookupFailed: Product lookup failed. You can enter details manually.
inventory.scanHint: Point the camera at the barcode
inventory.cameraError: Camera access denied or not supported.
inventory.emptyDescription: Add your first item to start tracking. Expiry alerts are calculated automatically.
inventory.urgentDescription: Critical items are shown at the top of the list.
inventory.quickAddDescription: Scan a barcode or enter manually. Add expiry dates to get expiration alerts.
